summary: Micware Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the acquisition of the remaining 30% stakes in its subsidiaries Micware Asia Pacific (Thailand) and Micware North America (California) from principal shareholders O-Well and Uni Electronics. On July 31, 2026, Micware purchased 10,000 total shares of Micware Asia Pacific for THB12.9 million (THB1,290/share) and 3,000,000 total shares of Micware North America for US$1.8 million (US$0.60/share), making both wholly owned. Consideration was cash. The filing also noted an ongoing internal reorganization announced on Form 6-K dated July 10, 2026, involving absorption-type company splits of Micware and certain subsidiaries (Micware Automotive, Micware Mobility, Micware Navigations) and the launch of Micware Spacia. No advisors or recommendation were disclosed. The purchase is a related-party transaction eliminating minority interests; the terms may be audited for fairness. The reorganization is a structural step that may precede further corporate actions or spin-off activities.
